data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Naasihah means 'advisor' or 'counselor'. It is derived from the verb nasaha, which means 'to advise' or 'to give good counsel'. This name is deeply rooted in Islamic spirituality, emphasizing the importance of guiding and supporting others. The name Naasihah carries the meaning “Advisor, Counselor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naasihah usually hope their child will grow to embody advisor, counselor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
